exercises.why: **сбил** — сби́ть (perfective): to knock down; to cause to fall, to shake down; to put out; to tread down. Wiktionary: с- + бить.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **выбил** — вы́бить (perfective): to beat out, to knock out, to dislodge. Wiktionary: вы́- + бить.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: I'll knock all your teeth out.
exercises.why: **выбью** — вы́бить (perfective): to beat out, to knock out, to dislodge. Wiktionary: вы́- + бить.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **сбивал** — сбива́ть (imperfective): to knock down, to shake down, to cause to fall; to knock down, to beat down; to put out; to tread down. Wiktionary: сбить + -вать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **сбивай** — сбива́ть (imperfective): to knock down, to shake down, to cause to fall; to knock down, to beat down; to put out; to tread down. Wiktionary: сбить + -вать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to beat off (an attack; enemies), to repulse
to knock down, to shake down, to cause to fall
to drive in (nail), to hammer in, to nail up
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: отби́ть — to beat off (an attack; enemies), to repulse; сбива́ть — to knock down, to shake down, to cause to fall; изби́ть — to beat, to thrash (unmercifully); заби́ть — to drive in (nail), to hammer in, to nail up.
**избил** — изби́ть (perfective): to beat, to thrash (unmercifully). Wiktionary: из- + бить.

exercises.why: **прибью** — приби́ть (perfective): to nail down (to attach with a nail); to move, to drive somewhere (of the wind or water); to press to the ground (by an impact or by wind or water); (colloquial) to kill. Wiktionary: при- + бить.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: My sister's going to kill me.
exercises.why: **прибьёт** — приби́ть (perfective): to nail down (to attach with a nail); to move, to drive somewhere (of the wind or water); to press to the ground (by an impact or by wind or water); (colloquial) to kill. Wiktionary: при- + бить.

exercises.q: He loaded his stomach with food.
exercises.why: **набил** — наби́ть (perfective): to stuff, to pack, to fill; to fix (onto); (colloquial) to type (some text); to break, to smash (a lot of something). Wiktionary: на- + бить.

to break, to crash, to crush, to smash, to shatter
to stuff, to pack, to fill
to beat off (an attack; enemies), to repulse
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: приби́ть — to nail down (to attach with a nail); разбива́ть — to break, to crash, to crush, to smash, to shatter; наби́ть — to stuff, to pack, to fill; отбива́ть — to beat off (an attack; enemies), to repulse.
